biomarkers.name: ER, PR
biomarkers.prevalence: ER positive in the great majority (~90% or higher); PR commonly positive

biomarkers.name: HER2
biomarkers.prevalence: Usually negative; HER2 amplification/overexpression is rare (<5%)

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Islands of tumour cells floating in pools of extracellular mucin
variants: pure mucinous (>90% mucin content — best prognosis)

tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Extensive extracellular mucin pools; delicate fibrovascular septa

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Luminal epithelial cells with mucinous differentiation
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Well-differentiated luminal (usually ER+/PR+/HER2-) with abundant extracellular mucin; type B may show neuroendocrine differentiation
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Type B mucinous with neuroendocrine differentiation reflects a convergent phenotype within breast carcinoma
